text:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning to run the users.email schema migration + backfill tonight at 23:00 UTC. 2h quiet window, dual-write enabled for 3h. Need deploy owner, smoke owner, rollback owner.

maya: I can own the deploy (onsite). I'll be available from 22:30 UTC for prechecks.

sam: I’ll take smoke tests and can validate traffic + traces, will run the smoke checklist and post results in #incidents if anything weird.

jordan: I’ll be rollback lead. Rollback plan is a fast toggle to stop dual-write + queue backfill cancel, then revert schema via the reverse migration. I’ll be on-call.

nina: Backups: running a full logical snapshot at 22:15 UTC (estimated 12m). Will post S3 path when done. Please don’t start any destructive ops until I confirm.

alex: Thanks. CI bot scheduled a maintenance window: maintenance: 2026-06-12T23:00Z -> 2026-06-13T01:00Z. @maya confirm you want canary traffic at T+10m? :eyes:

maya: yes please. Start canary at 23:10 UTC with 1% traffic for 10m, then ramp to 10% for 15m, then full. If any error spikes >1.5x baseline, abort and call rollback.

sam: Smoke checklist snippet:
```
- run ./smoke/run_smoke.sh --env=prod --sample=100
- check per-route latency, 95th < 350ms
- run embed and generation sanity prompts
- verify 5 random user rows for email correctness
```
I’ll paste results after each step.

alex: Migration commands we’ll run (ops-runbook):
```bash
# apply schema migration
redwood-migrate apply --file migrations/20260612_add_email_index.sql
# enable dual-write flag
redwood-flags set users_dualwrite true --duration=3h
# start backfill (sharded)
./backfill --model users.email --shards 16 --batch 500 --parallel 4
```
Note: backfill is sharded to avoid long locks.

jordan: Rollback steps if needed:
- stop new writes -> redwood-flags set users_dualwrite false
- cancel backfill jobs: `pkill -f backfill || redwood-jobs cancel --tag users.email`
- run reverse migration (safe): `redwood-migrate apply --file migrations/20260612_reverse.sql`
- run quick integrity scan to ensure no partial writes.
If we hit >3% data divergence or >2min write lat increase, we rollback.

nina: Backup completed: s3://redwood-db-backups/2026-06-12/users-full-20260612-2215.dump.gz (sha256: 9f8a...). Verified.

maya: Pre-deploy preflight (I'll run at 22:40):
- confirm replicas are healthy (lag < 10s)
- confirm disk <70%
- confirm no long-running tx
- confirm dashboard alerts set for error rate and 95p latency
I'll post ✅ when all green.

sam: Also will monitor:
- perf dashboard: /dashboards/users-write-ops
- logs: query `service:users AND env:prod AND level:error`
- traces: samplers on 5% of traffic during ramp

alex: Small rollback drill now: @jordan run your cancel command in staging to confirm steps. Jordan?

jordan: did a dry-run in staging earlier. Cancel command sequence: `redwood-jobs list --tag users.email` -> `redwood-jobs cancel <job-id>` works. Will repeat a 2-step dry-run at 22:50.

ci-bot: deploy window created in pagerduty and calendar. Reminders set at 22:15, 22:45, 23:00.

maya: ✅ Preflight done at 22:45 — replicas healthy, disk 48%, no long tx, alerts configured. Ready for deploy.

sam: I’ll start smoke at 23:11 (canary). Will post results after each gate.

alex: Thanks all. Final call: thumbs-up to proceed? Drop a :thumbsup: here if you’re good.

maya: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

nina: :thumbsup:

alex: Launching per plan at 23:00 UTC. If anyone sees anything critical, call @jordan immediately and we'll stop dual-write and roll back.

sam: 23:12 canary results: smoke passed, 95p latency stable, error rate unchanged. Ramp to 10%.

maya: 23:30 full traffic — all green. Backfill progress: shard 1-4 done, overall ~28% complete, ETA ~1h 45m.

jordan: Rolling quick integrity scan now — small mismatch in 0.01% of rows flagged, investigating. If it rises above 0.1% we roll back.

sam: keeping an eye on traces. Nothing alarming yet.

alex: Great work. Will leave this thread open for any follow-ups and post final backfill completion.

maya: final: backfill completed at 01:32 UTC, post-migration scan clean. Closing window. :tada:
